name: grilled-product-dev
description: Turn a vague product request into an approved specification and vertical tickets.

loop.goal: Produce an approved specification and ticket set for a product-development request.

steps.title: Clarify the request one question at a time
steps.instruction: Ask one focused question, include your recommended answer, and wait for explicit approval before advancing.

steps.title: Write the approved specification
steps.instruction: Turn the approved direction into the canonical specification and wait for explicit approval before advancing.

steps.title: Slice the specification into vertical tickets
steps.instruction: Write dependency-aware vertical tickets, then log the result.
